verdict: Spend is producing sales but leads are nearly nonexistent — the funnel is misaligned with a leads objective.
diagnosis: $6,899 spent this period generated only 2 leads and 9 purchases worth $5,897, leaving return on ad spend below breakeven.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $6,899 spend
signals.detail: Cost per lead landed near $3,449 this period, far above any healthcare norm. The leads objective is not firing.

signals.headline: 9 purchases at $655 revenue each
signals.detail: Sales are happening at $5,897 total value this period, but volume is too thin to justify current spend.

signals.headline: Click-through rate 0.08% average
signals.detail: Ads are being served but barely clicked. Creative, audience, or keyword match is off for this period.

signals.headline: Cost per click averaged $2.08
signals.detail: Click pricing is reasonable for healthcare this period. The problem is what happens after the click, not auction cost.

signals.headline: Only 138 landing page views logged
signals.detail: Of 4,251 clicks this period, few reached the page. Tracking or page load issues are likely bleeding budget.

recommendations.title: Audit lead tracking on the Belle Watch landing page
recommendations.detail: Only 138 landing page views were recorded against 4,251 clicks. Consider verifying pixel firing, form submission events, and page speed before adding more budget.

recommendations.title: Test shifting objective from leads to purchases
recommendations.detail: Purchase actions outnumber leads 9 to 2 this period. Worth exploring a purchase-optimized campaign since buyers convert faster than form-fillers here.

recommendations.title: Refresh creative for the 0.08% click-through rate
recommendations.detail: Engagement is weak this period. Consider testing adult-child caregiver angles and fall-detection messaging, which the category data shows drives purchase intent.
